telemetry_note: 500 ms nvidia-smi sampling; counters may lag and do not measure SM occupancy; short rows may have no samples
scheduling_note: host_schedule_wall_ms is measured only in F-A; E zero is an uninstrumented placeholder. Thread CPU counters are quantized and may report zero for short work.
replay_note: Per-band event spans include zeroing and difference restoration; E additionally includes checkpoint H2D; they are not pure VLC kernel durations.
